summary: P0=0, P1=0, P2=0, P3=0, verdict=pass. An independent W4 audit reviewed the current 19-file cpdb-libs change set plus this audit record against SKILL.md, code-style.md, review-memory.md, R51, and R52. CI #44261 is closed by a real compatibility path rather than a test bypass: tools/run-tests.sh still starts the built frontend, sends stop, enforces the five-second timeout, and requires the original 'Stopping front end' success assertion. When dbus-run-session is present the upstream session-bus invocation is preserved; when absent the test unsets DBUS_SESSION_BUS_ADDRESS and exercises the frontend's real no-bus startup and clean shutdown. The shared build selects the real .libs ELF to avoid the HMDFS libtool-wrapper failure, while the static build keeps the normal executable. Execution evidence records the old isolated-PATH script failing rc=1 with dbus-run-session not found, the patched shared/static isolated-PATH cases both returning rc=0, shared/static conan create with a session runner passing, full build_and_test.sh passing 1/1, and conan-verify G0-G4 passing. The current W3 log independently shows make check running run-tests.sh with TOTAL=1, PASS=1, SKIP=0 and the HarmonyOS consumer API test passing. All six patches dry-run cleanly against the specified official OpenPrinting 2.0b5 archive, whose independently computed SHA-256 matches conandata and manifest. No empty test, skip, forged result/hash, OHOS patch macro, manual binary, local/mirror source URL, undefined shell compiler input, cross-package change, or report contradiction was found. The upstream archive contains exactly one registered Automake test, and notes/test-report truthfully record its execution and the consumer test.
